status: APPROVED - frozen; val once, exact val replay, test-dev once
split_for_test: VisDrone val (548 images) once, then VisDrone test-dev (1610 images) once, after approval
reporting_rules: Pre-registered questions E-H1, E-H2 (per s), E-H3 as in the addendum: verdict per detector for YOLO26s, paired bootstrap over val images (1000, seed 0), eps = 0.30; Holm appendix for YOLO26s alone (one-model family = unadjusted). The five-model verdicts, '>= 4 of 5' and the pooled effect are unchanged; YOLO26s counts in no family criterion.
Test-dev: the same definitions as held-out confirmation, reported next to val.
Every frozen row is reported regardless of outcome; no retuning, re-selection or added rows after val.
Exploratory rows (X-grid, decomposition D) in separate tables, labelled post hoc, never in a verdict.
Primary protocol visdrone_ignore (toolkit port, cap 500 per image); plain as a secondary column.

G-E2 (s model): E-1280 (o2o) within +-5 AP of YOLOv10s E-1280 (B-FULL 1280, val 33.66), checked after the single val evaluation; otherwise checked and reported, changes no verdict (addendum 7bc0ace item 6).

Descriptive equal-compute comparison (addendum 7bc0ace item 8): single pass YOLO26s at 2048 px vs. single pass YOLO26m at 1280 px, both o2o (rows E-2048 / E-1280): GFLOPs per image (exact per input shape, scahi.flops, over the val / test-dev images) and AP on val and test-dev, delta with paired bootstrap CI (1000, seed 0); no verdict, no threshold.
